method: Third historical-vintage pass. Sourced growing-season chronology is stored independently from bounded derived matrix effects.

growingSeason.winter: unusually warm; January at Winningen averaged 5.6°C
growingSeason.earlySummer: May and June were mostly dry and warm; hot dry June caused drought stress especially in young vines
growingSeason.midSummer: July brought sunburn problems, followed by heavy rain from late July
growingSeason.september: very warm nights reduced cooling and accelerated ripening; some sites gained 3-4 degrees Oechsle per day
growingSeason.harvest: wide site and variety variability; substantial selection was needed

styleEffects: Riesling combined pronounced fruit with a strong acidity-sweetness balance
noble rot created opportunities for high-quality sweet wines
site and water-supply differences were unusually important

growingSeason.lateSummer: vines were in excellent condition at the end of August and ripeness was about two weeks ahead of the previous year
growingSeason.september: heavy rain changed grape health rapidly, with strong downstream differences in rainfall
growingSeason.harvest: earliest start and fastest finish reported for the region; Pinot varieties, sparkling base and Kabinett Riesling were harvested in the first half of September; main Riesling harvest began around 2025-09-19

styleEffects: very rapid harvest decisions were important
Riesling maturity and health varied strongly by site
selection pressure increased sharply on steep slopes after September rain

growingSeason.earlyFrosts: major frosts between 2021-10-06 and 2021-10-08 reached about -4°C to -6°C in some places; cooler Uco Valley sectors suffered significant yield reduction
growingSeason.summer: December and January were comparatively cool; December rain increased downy-mildew risk; February brought rain, cloud and humidity and slowed red-grape ripening
growingSeason.ucoTemperature: Gualtallary was cooler than in many other years and accumulated temperatures fell below average during the cloudy February period
growingSeason.march: warm days created a strong harvest window with slow red-grape ripening and good phenolic development
growingSeason.lateFrost: a cold front on 2022-03-30 to 2022-03-31 hit higher, cooler Mendoza sectors including the Uco Valley

styleEffects: fresh expressive wines where disease and harvest timing were managed well
red wines developed fleshy gentle tannins and notable color
Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon and Malbec achieved strong potential in successfully harvested sites
